# accessors.coef_images { #fmrimod.accessors.coef_images }

```python
coef_images(x, statistic='estimate', type='estimates', coefs=None, mask=None)
```

Return one named coefficient/statistic map per requested name.

Plural companion to `coef_image`. ``type`` selects estimates,
t-contrasts, or F-contrasts. Unknown ``coefs`` raise.
